subtitle: Pitch and Formant Shifter
tagline: Moves pitch across four octaves and the formant across two, independently, with real-time FFT processing and a fixed, reported latency.

body.lead: TB Pitch Shifter is a focused tool for moving pitch and formant separately. `PITCH` shifts the harmonic spacing from −24 to +24 semitones. `FORMANT` moves the perceived size of a voice or instrument across its own range of −12 to +12 semitones, without forcing the note to follow.

body.p: With only two main controls you can make clean octave changes, bigger or smaller characters, transformed effects, or tonal reshaping that speed-based playback cannot achieve. Processing runs in real time in mono or stereo, with smooth automation, a fixed reported latency, and an aligned bypass. With both controls at 0 st, the output returns exactly to the dry signal.

ul: `FORMANT` from −12 to +12 semitones, independent of the note
Real-time FFT processing for mono and stereo
Fixed reported latency and latency-aligned bypass
Exact dry output at 0 st on both controls
5 factory presets, user presets, undo, and redo

note.title: About this manual
text: This manual describes TB Pitch Shifter 2.0.0 for Windows (VST3). The current macOS build is version 1.0.2 and may differ from the descriptions here.

ol: Insert TB Pitch Shifter on a vocal or instrument track. Both controls start at 0 st, which leaves the sound unchanged.
Turn `PITCH` to transpose: +12 st is an octave up, −12 st an octave down.
Turn `FORMANT` to change the apparent size: negative values sound larger and darker, positive values smaller and brighter.
Use the Female to Male or Male to Female presets as starting points for voice changes.

rows: Previous and next preset, the preset browser (factory and saved user presets; Custom after a change), Save, Undo, and Redo.
Moves the pitch with natural spectral and formant movement. Large shifts make processing artifacts more audible.
Offsets the spectral envelope relative to the transposed signal. Negative values sound larger and darker; positive values smaller and brighter. Extreme values sound unnatural.

body.p: TB Pitch Shifter also has a host Bypass parameter. The plug-in reports a fixed latency to the host, and the bypassed signal stays time-aligned with the processed one.

tip.text: To change a voice's character without changing the note, leave PITCH at 0 st and move only FORMANT.

body.p: Step through presets with the arrows, or open the preset browser to choose a factory or saved user preset. Save stores the current settings as a .tbps file. Undo and Redo step through recent parameter and preset changes.
Starting points for common jobs. Adjust them by ear.

recipes.title: Octave layer
recipes.use: A doubled octave under or over a lead.
steps: Blend the shifted track under the original with the mixer fader.

recipes.title: Voice change
settings: Female to Male or Male to Female
steps: Small formant changes are often more convincing than large pitch changes.

recipes.title: Bigger or smaller character
recipes.use: A creature, robot, or cartoon voice.
steps: Keep PITCH near 0 so the words stay on the original notes.

recipes.title: Instrument tone reshaping
recipes.use: Darker or brighter body on guitar or synth.
steps: Compare with bypass at matched loudness.

The voice sounds like a chipmunk or a giant.

Make sure the host's latency compensation is on; the plug-in reports its fixed latency.
Both controls are at 0 st, or the host Bypass parameter is on.

Lower-hop STFT processing, smoother formant automation, and an exact dry signal at the neutral setting. The editor was redesigned as a bright dual-instrument panel; Pitch and Formant stay independent.
Independent Pitch (±24 st) and Formant (±12 st), five factory presets, and user preset saving and loading.
